tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Letterbox bars, 300 px top and bottom on a 1080x1920 frame. Pure black, never grey.

tokens.name: subtitle
tokens.usage: Subtitle text in the bottom bar. Warm cream, not pure white.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Chapter headlines, names and numerals over dimmed footage.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Muted gold. The one accent: italic emphasis words, chapter kickers, thin rules, the number that matters.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels and sources on dimmed footage.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Faint hairlines between figure rows.

tokens.name: footage
tokens.usage: The look on all talking footage (CSS filter). Deeper blacks, less colour, a little warmth.

tokens.name: dimmed
tokens.usage: Footage under a chapter card or a figure.

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Darkens the frame edges only. Never on the face. No grain, no light leaks.

tokens.name: letterbox
tokens.usage: Height of each black bar on a 1080x1920 frame. The picture is 1080x1320 between them.

tokens.name: subtitle-bottom
tokens.usage: Subtitle distance from the bottom edge: centred in the bottom bar.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of figures on a 1080-wide frame.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Keep all text at least this far from every frame edge.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: Bars and rules have square corners.

tokens.name: fade-in
tokens.usage: A headline line, a name or a numeral fading up. GSAP: power2.out. Subtitles use 0.5s.

tokens.name: fade-out
tokens.usage: About half a fade-in. GSAP: power2.in. Subtitles use 0.35s.

tokens.name: line-stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between kicker, first line and second line of a chapter card.

tokens.name: rule-draw
tokens.usage: The gold rule drawing out from its centre. GSAP: power3.out.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Footage dimming under a card (ease-in-out), and 0.6s coming back.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: The footage dim and its return.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Minimum time a chapter card stays still. Long holds are the look.
